headline: Your Business, Running on AI.
{Your Team, Back on What Matters.}
hero.intro: We build AI agents that answer and call every enquiry, automations that follow up and move your data, and websites that bring in the work. You get the hours back. Your customers get a faster reply.
hero.primaryButton: See What AI Can Do for You

problems.heading: How Many Hours Did Your Team Lose to Busywork This Week?
problems.intro: If any of these sound familiar, that’s time and revenue slipping away every single day. The good news: most of it can be handed to AI.

items.title: The same questions, all day
items.text: Prices, availability, “how does it work?” Your team answers them by hand while the enquiries that matter wait in line.

items.title: Leads that go cold
items.text: A lead that waits hours for a reply often books with someone else. When everyone’s busy, follow-ups are the first thing to slip.

items.title: Copy, paste, repeat
items.text: Details typed from emails and forms into your CRM, sheets and invoices. Slow, boring and easy to get wrong.

items.title: Tools that don’t talk
items.text: Your CRM, inbox, forms and spreadsheets each hold part of the story, so your people end up being the glue.

solutions.heading: Put AI on the Work Nobody Wants to Do.
solutions.intro: Here’s what we build. Every system is designed around how your business already runs, and your people stay in charge of the decisions that matter.

items.title: Workflows that run themselves
items.text: An order, form or email turns into the right records, invoices and messages automatically. No re-typing, no missed steps.

items.title: AI that qualifies your leads
items.text: Every new lead is read and scored against your criteria, and the promising ones land with the right person in minutes, not days.

items.title: Enquiries answered in minutes
items.text: Website, email and WhatsApp enquiries collected in one place and answered from your own information, with your team approving where you want.

items.title: AI agents that take action
items.text: Agents that call leads, book appointments and update your tools, working inside the limits you set and asking before anything important.

showcase.heading: Watch an Automation Do a Day’s Work in Seconds.
showcase.intro: Pick a workflow and press run. From a simple follow-up email to an AI voice agent that calls every new enquiry within a minute.

workflows.title: Every enquiry gets a call back in under a minute.
workflows.summary: Most enquiries go cold while they wait for a reply. Here an AI voice agent phones each new lead straight away, answers their questions from your own information and books them in, while your team gets on with the work in front of them.
workflows.done: Enquiry called, appointment booked, owner notified

steps.title: Every channel, one flow
steps.text: Website forms, lead ads and missed calls start the same workflow. Duplicates are removed and each lead is saved to your CRM.

steps.title: Called straight away
steps.text: Inside your opening hours, the AI voice agent calls the lead immediately. Outside them, it waits and calls as soon as you open.

steps.title: A real conversation
steps.text: It introduces itself as an AI assistant, answers from your own prices and FAQs, qualifies the lead and offers free slots from your calendar.

steps.title: The right next step
steps.text: Booked calls get a confirmation message. Warm leads go to your sales team, unanswered calls are retried, and the rest are updated in the CRM.

steps.title: Logged and summarised
steps.text: Every call is saved with a transcript and a short summary, and you get a note of what happened.

workflows.title: A Workflow That Follows Up, So Nobody Has To.
workflows.summary: A simpler one, and a good place to start: it emails new leads, reads the replies and sends the next message on its own, so no lead is forgotten.
workflows.done: Example run finished: every step succeeded

steps.title: Runs on a schedule
steps.text: Every hour on working days, it reads your lead list from a spreadsheet.

steps.title: Writes the first email
steps.text: New leads get an email personalised with AI from the details you hold, then sent from your own inbox.

steps.title: Watches for replies
steps.text: It checks each email thread. When someone replies, your team is told and the sequence stops.

steps.title: Follows up and logs it
steps.text: No reply after the wait you set? It sends the next email in the same thread and records when.

workflows.title: Your week in numbers, written up before Monday starts.
workflows.summary: Sales, enquiries and call outcomes collected from your tools every Monday morning, then turned by AI into a short plain-English report sent to your phone and inbox.

steps.title: Gathers the numbers
steps.text: At 8 am every Monday it reads last week’s sales, enquiries and call outcomes from the tools you already use.

steps.title: Writes the summary
steps.text: An AI model turns the figures into a short report and compares them with the week before.

steps.title: Sends it to you
steps.text: The summary arrives as a chat message, with the full report attached as a PDF by email.

showcase.note: Example workflows, shown for illustration. Every build is designed around your own tools, timings and rules.

items.q: What is AI automation, in simple terms?
items.a: It’s software that handles the routine parts of your work for you. Workflow automation moves information between your tools and triggers the next step, and AI reads, sorts, summarises and drafts replies. Together they can answer enquiries, follow up leads or prepare reports, while your team handles anything that needs judgement.

items.q: How much time can AI automation save my team?
items.a: It depends on the work. Tasks that happen often and follow a pattern, like replying to common enquiries, chasing leads or copying data between tools, are where the biggest savings usually are. We look at your actual process before estimating anything, so you get a realistic picture, not a sales pitch.

items.q: Which business tasks can be automated?
items.a: The best candidates happen often and follow similar steps each time: handling enquiries, routing and qualifying leads, follow-up reminders, appointment booking, data entry between tools, invoices and weekly reports. Tasks that need careful judgement on every case usually keep a person in charge.

items.q: Will I have to replace my existing software?
items.a: Usually not. We connect the tools you already use, such as your CRM, inbox, forms, spreadsheets and WhatsApp, wherever they support it. If something can’t be connected, we explain your options before anything is built.

items.q: What’s the difference between an AI agent and regular automation?
items.a: Regular automation follows fixed rules: the same input always leads to the same steps. An AI agent understands each case and decides its next step from a set of actions you allow, like answering a question, booking a slot or passing it to your team. Agents handle variety; fixed automation is simpler when the steps never change. Most systems use both.

items.q: Can an AI agent really call my leads?
items.a: Yes. An AI voice agent can phone each new enquiry within a minute, introduce itself as an AI assistant, answer questions from your own information and book a time in your calendar. Anything it can’t handle goes straight to your team, and every call is logged with a summary.
